name: RelaxHere
description: Let the whole party relax nearby while the player stays put.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for members of your Nether's Follower Framework party. Acts on the whole party.
prompt: If the player tells the party to relax, rest or make themselves comfortable here, begin your response with '{key}:'
